response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY), pair_rates AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS benchmark_avg FROM matched) SELECT AVG(p.pair_avg), AVG(p.pair_avg - b.benchmark_avg) FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.pair_avg > b.benchmark_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the average net fee rate across matched fee–order records, so each matched record has equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark gives each trading pair equal weight: it is the average of the per-pair average net fee rates.
